title: Find the Longest Repeated Phrase
real_world_story: A plagiarism analysis system examines a document to detect sections of text that have been repeated within the same document, which can indicate duplicated or reused content.

real_world_connection.system: Document analysis and plagiarism detection system
real_world_connection.input_represents: Text contained within a single document
real_world_connection.target_represents: The longest continuous text section that appears at least twice
real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Comparing repeated portions of the document to identify the longest duplicated phrase

problem_statement: Given a document string, find the length of the longest substring that appears at least twice in the document. The repeated occurrences may overlap. If no substring is repeated, print -1.
task: Analyze the document and return the length of its longest repeated substring.
input_format: The first line contains the document string.
output_format: Print the length of the longest repeated substring. If no substring occurs more than once, print -1.
constraints: Document contains only lowercase English letters
Overlapping repeated substrings must be considered

examples.explanation: The substring 'ana' occurs twice, so the longest repeated substring has length 3.
No substring occurs more than once in the document.
The substring 'aaaa' occurs more than once through overlapping occurrences.

expected_algorithm.name: Longest Repeated Substring using String Comparison
expected_algorithm.reason: Repeated document sections can be identified by comparing substrings that begin at different positions and tracking the longest matching sequence.

hint: Compare substrings that begin at different positions in the document.
Track the length of the continuous matching section between two starting positions.
Keep the maximum length found across all pairs of positions.
real_world_takeaway: Detecting repeated phrases can help identify duplicated sections, reused content, and repetitive text within documents.
